text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the big showdown at Nakayama 
Racecourse, the Arima Kinen, has arrived 
amid thunderous cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing on a stage that luck alone could 
never have brought her to, 
Matikanefukukitaru declares that she will 
run with everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And putting her heart into becoming a 
"Fortune Girl" who brings happiness to all 
by running with everything she has... she 
takes on the Arima Kinen!
